metadata.title: Your account
metadata.description: Sign in for your own overview, notifications when you're in a draw, players and clubs to follow, EloStonk and a vote on what Elodrop does next.

benefits.title: What you get

overview.title: Your own overview
overview.text: Say which player is you, and see your next tournament as soon as the draw is out (your group, your chances, your draw luck), your last weeks, each season in review, your career and where you stand.

notifications.title: Draw notifications
notifications.text: A notification on your phone when a newly published draw includes you.

follow.title: Follow players and clubs
follow.text: Their ratings and the week's change on the front page.

elostonk.title: EloStonk (beta)
elostonk.text: Pick a squad of 5, make one your captain, and play in leagues with your friends.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.text: Vote for what Elodrop does next, and suggest your own.

mistakes.title: Fix mistakes about you
mistakes.text: Report a wrong club, a match that isn't yours or a missing tournament from your own player page.

benefits.terms: Free, and no password: we email you a code. Every page stays open to everyone, and you can delete your account at any time (<link>privacy</link>).

card.title: Make Elodrop yours
card.description: A free account adds things just for you.
card.link: Sign in or create an account

prompts.player: Is this you? <link>Sign in</link> for your own overview and a notification when you're in a draw.
prompts.draw: <link>Sign in</link> to get a notification on your phone when you're in a draw.

signIn.intro: Free, and every page stays open to everyone. An account adds things just for you.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It works for an hour.
signIn.gmail: Gmail? <google>Continue with Google</google> instead: no code needed, and it's the same account.
signIn.googleFailed: Signing in with Google didn't go through. Try again, or sign in with a code by email.
signIn.sendFailed: The code couldn't be sent. Check the address, or try again in a minute.
signIn.codeFailed: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.

profile.title: Create your account
profile.nicknameHelp: 3–20 letters, digits, _ . or -, no spaces. It's shown on leaderboards and with the ideas you suggest, never with your name or email. You can change it once every 30 days.
profile.privacy: I've read how Elodrop handles my data
profile.tooYoung: Accounts are for ages {age} and over, so none was made, and your sign-in has been deleted. A parent can follow your player page with their own account.

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.settings: You can change all of this later: who you are and notifications in your account's settings, who you follow with the stars, and your squad on EloStonk's page.
welcome.followIntro: Your teammates, rivals or favourites: the players you follow show up on your front page with their ratings and how they moved last week. You can also follow players and clubs with the star on their pages.
welcome.stonkIntro: The site's fantasy game: pick 5 players and make one your captain, and score each round from how much better than expected they play. Pick your first squad below, or skip it and play later.

settings.nicknameLocked: You can change it again from {date}.

me.title: This is me
me.intro: Pick yourself among the players. Only you see it: it marks your player page and puts your rating on the front page.
me.label: You are
me.locked: You can choose someone else from {date}.
me.confirm: Are you {name}? Once you've chosen, you can't choose someone else for {days} days.
me.confirmClear: Remove {name} as you? You can't choose anyone again until {date}.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Get a notification on this device when a tournament draw on Elodrop includes you, as soon as it's published.
notifications.noClaim: Choose who you are under "This is me" first: the notifications are about your player.
notifications.install: On iPhone, notifications come to the installed app only: add Elodrop to your home screen, open it from there, and turn them on here.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for Elodrop in this browser's settings. Allow them there, then come back.
notifications.turnOn: Turn on notifications on this device
notifications.failed: Notifications couldn't be turned on. Try again.

following.title: Following
following.description: You and the players and clubs you follow: their ratings and how they moved last week, their draws coming up and their latest results.
following.empty: Follow players with the star on their page, and they show up here.
following.manage: The players and clubs you follow. Press the cross to stop following one.
following.toWinTitle: Chance of winning the event, from the draw and the ratings
following.upsetTitle: Won with less than a 30% chance

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.intro: Everything goes at once: your profile, follows, tournaments, votes and reports. Ideas you suggested stay, without your name.
danger.warning: This can't be undone. Your account and everything in it are deleted at once, and can't be brought back.

errors.too_young: Accounts are for ages 15 and over.
errors.nickname_blocked: That username can't be used. Try another.
errors.nickname_taken: That username is taken. Try another.
errors.claim_too_soon: You chose a player less than 30 days ago.
errors.account_too_new: Your account is too new for this yet.
errors.too_many_pending: You have 3 ideas waiting to be looked at already.
errors.too_many_stories: You have 3 stories waiting to be read already.
errors.story_twice: You've sent in a story about this match already.
errors.reports_off: Reports are switched off for now.
errors.reports_blocked: You can't send reports any more.
errors.not_your_player: You can only report mistakes about yourself, 14 days after choosing who you are.
errors.report_open: You have a report waiting already.
errors.too_many_reports: You've sent 3 reports in the last 90 days.
errors.player_reported: This player has reports waiting already.
errors.squad_invalid: A squad is 5 different players, one of them captain.
errors.not_eligible: One of the players can't be picked (under 18, or neither active nor rated in singles, doubles and mixed).
errors.too_many_from_club: A squad can have at most 2 players from one club.
errors.needs_both_genders: A squad needs at least one man and one woman.
errors.too_many_leagues: You're in as many leagues as you can be.
errors.not_owner: Only the league's owner can do that.
errors.too_many_tries: Too many wrong codes. Try again in an hour.
errors.too_fast: Hold on a moment, then save again.
errors.name_blocked: That name can't be used. Try another.
errors.username_too_soon: You changed your username less than 30 days ago.
errors.username_invalid: Use 3–20 letters, digits, _ . or -, with no spaces.

report.title: Report a mistake
report.intro: Something wrong on your page? Tell us what, and it's checked by hand. You can send one at a time and 3 in 90 days.
report.noteHelp: Up to 280 characters. Don't write anything about others.
report.sent: Thanks. It will be checked by hand, and you can follow it on your account page.
report.declinedNote: A second declined report ends reporting for your account.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.description: What could Elodrop do next? Vote for the ideas you want, or suggest one.
ideas.intro: What could Elodrop do next? Vote for the ideas you'd use. The most wanted come first, and the ones being worked on are marked.
ideas.signIn: <link>Sign in</link> to vote and suggest ideas.

suggest.title: Suggest an idea
suggest.intro: Ideas are read before they're shown, with your username. You can have 2 waiting at a time.
suggest.name: The idea, in a line
suggest.sent: Thanks! It's shown once it has been read.
suggest.tooNew: Accounts can suggest ideas from 3 days after they're made.
suggest.contact: Elodrop may email me about this idea
suggest.contactHelp: To ask about it or talk it through. Your email address is never shown to anyone.

overview.noClaim: Pick yourself among the players, and your numbers show up here: your next tournament, your recent weeks, each season and your career.

next.title: Your next tournament
next.note: Your chance against each from your ratings now. Draw luck: above zero your draw helps, below it hurts, against a fair draw (as on the tournament page).

season.title: Season in review
season.underdogHelp: Matches you had under a 50 % chance of winning
season.deciderHelp: Matches that went to a third set
season.closeHelp: Matches whose last set was decided by 3 points or fewer

career.title: Career and form
career.nemesisHelp: The opponents you've lost to most (at least 3 losses)
career.chemistryHelp: Points a match against expectation with each partner you've played with more than once: above zero, you play better together than your ratings say.
career.strongestHelp: Points a match against expectation: above zero, you do better there than your rating says.

stonk.title: Your stonk
stonk.none: No EloStonk squad has picked you yet.
